per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be portable and run on various operating systems including Linux, Windows, and Solaris.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product will function alongside server software on any operating system where the Java runtime can be installed.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be deployable on various web or application servers such as Tomcat or JBoss.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must make use of web/application server technology. Open source examples include Apache web server Tomcat and the JBoss application server.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should be compatible with various database management systems including Postgres, Oracle, and SQL Server.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must work with most database management systems (DBMS) on the market whether the DBMS is colocated with the product on the same machine or is located on a different machine on the computer network.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should respond to user actions within 5 seconds for small tasks and within 8 seconds for heavier tasks.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The response shall be fast enough to avoid interrupting the user's flow of thought. 90% of tasks shall complete within 5 seconds. 98% of tasks shall complete within 8 seconds.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should handle at least 1,000 simultaneous requests today and scale to handle approximately 2,000 simultaneous requests by the next release.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall be capable of handling up to 1 000 concurrent requests. This number will increase to 2 000 by Release 2. The concurrency capacity must be able to handle peak scheduling times such as early morning and late afternoon hours.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should achieve 99.99% uptime, excluding hardware failures.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Aside from server failure the software product shall achieve 99.99% up time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should only allow access to company employees or explicitly approved external users, using LDAP or SAML for authentication.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall ensure that only company employees or external users with company-approved user IDs may have product access. 100% of all logons shall be by either company employees or external users with company-approved user IDs.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should sanitize inputs, validate everything server-side, and reject malicious input to maintain data integrity.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: The product shall prevent the input of malicious data. The product and/or adjacent hardware/software systems' data shall remain 100% uncorrupted each time malicious data is input into the product.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should capture exceptions and operational problems in logs with enough context for diagnosis and transmit aggregated exception data back to central support, scrubbing sensitive fields.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product shall create an exception log of problems encountered within the product for transmission to our company for analysis and resolution.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The codebase should follow standard design patterns and best practices, with good layering, clear interfaces, and test coverage, allowing new developers to integrate features within a couple of days.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'The product must be designed using Design Patterns and coding best practices. 90% of maintenance software developers are able to integrate new functionality into the product with 2 working days.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The UI should support localization, branding, and accessibility, including screen reader support, keyboard navigation, and proper semantics.
The system should work on modern, standards-compliant browsers and degrade gracefully where features aren't supported, with mobile access via responsive web UI.
The system should be runnable in clustered setups for high availability, with health endpoints for automated checks, and support rolling upgrades and externalized session state.
per_requirement.matched_ground_truth: 'Aside from server failure the software product shall achieve 99.99% up time.'

per_requirement.extracted_requirement: The system should not send personally identifiable information (PII) or full user content in external reports, scrubbing sensitive fields to comply with privacy laws.
The system should model equipment as first-class entities to support future enhancements such as room sensors.
